messages:
Ravi S.: kicking off discussion: proposing we convert the large "hotpath" runtime into three narrow, ownership-bound slices (ingest, transform, serve). want to align on interface boundaries and the deprecation ladder for the old monolith.
Lin T.: agree on slices, but we need a strict service contract doc: inputs, outputs, error semantics, auth surface. no implicit side-effects.
Harper G.: big concern is cross-slice sync for schema changes. we should adopt a two-phase compatibility rule: additive-only for 45 days, then migration window.
Ravi S.: thinking: metadata headers for route-version + schema-version so routers can assert compatibility at runtime and emit metric `schema_mismatch`.
Lin T.: +1. also add a lightweight runtime validator: if validator fails, reply with 412 and route to fallback path, log with trace-id.
Harper G.: fallback should be a stable shim that calls monolith read-path for correctness, even if slower. set fallback SLO to 2x p95 of normal.
Ravi S.: rollout plan sketch: feature-flagged dual-run for 2 weeks (reads via sticky routing), then gradual traffic shift 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% over 72h, with automated kill-switch on these triggers: spike in 5xx, p50 delta > 40%, or schema_mismatch rate > 0.1%.
Lin T.: we must protect tenant-specific flags. propose per-tenant opt-in during canary; default to off. document in migration playbook how to flip flags safely.
Harper G.: tech-debt paydown item: ticket to remove old endpoint and ramp down supporting code 60 days after cutover, unless rollback occurs. team owning slice must carry that ticket.
Ravi S.: operational guardrails: prefill KV cache from snapshot, warm worker pools with synthetic load, disable autoscale burst for the first 24h.
ops-bot: CI note  New pipeline `slice-extract-canary` created. Manual trigger only. See https://ci.internal/job/slice-extract-canary/1234
qa-bot: Test matrix added: contract tests, golden-record replay, rate-limit recovery, memory-leak smoke. will run nightly against canary.
Lin T.: metrics to add before cutover: `slice_errors`, `slice_p50`, `slice_p95`, `schema_mismatch`, `fallback_rate`, `canary_replay_failures`. Alerts scoped to canary channel.
Harper G.: ownership handoff: after prod cutover, ops retains SLA page for 30 days then hands to slice team. we should include a runbook + rollback playbook in the repo.
Ravi S.: timeline: PRs this week, staging canary next Wed, prod canary two weeks after pending sign-offs. Ill publish the deprecation ladder doc and tag owners.
Lin T.: acked. any blockers? my blocker: need backwards-compat schema helpers in shared lib.
Harper G.: acked. my blocker: migration backfill IO rate budget from storage team.
Ravi S.: ok. I'll coordinate with storage and shared-lib owners. thanks :thumbsup:
